result:
Contract established and grounded in verbatim source: **the value a hook returns when there is no live subscribable source must be identical to the value the first client (hydrating) render computes.** Confirmed violations: zustand hands back `getInitialState` (default/empty) as the server snapshot while the client computes from `getState` (`src/react.ts:30-34`, `src/traditional.ts:36-40`); react-redux falls back to the live `store.getState` when no `serverState` is provided (`useSelector.ts:246`); TanStack DB and preact-query call `useSyncExternalStore` with **no** server-snapshot argument at all (`useLiveQuery.ts:490`, `preact-query/src/utils.ts:16-19`) — which is the hard console error and dead subtree; and React's own shim documents that it *ignores* `getServerSnapshot` entirely (`useSyncExternalStoreShimServer.js:15-19`).
